before:
# 🧭️ Own workspace root: linked by `../📜️script.ts` (`cargo run --manifest-path`), never joins the
# repository's root workspace, whose root manifest is a shared, contended file.
#
# Builds this subset's `third-party-generated` fixtures with the SAME reference crate (`gif` 0.13)
# — never with this repository's own `encode_gif`. See `../📜️script.ts` for the generation contract.
#
# Two independent binaries, two independent oracles:
#   `generate` (src/main.rs)        — 🎬️pattern-strip.gif, untouched, backs the pre-existing
#                                     `gif-89a-any-mutate` CROSS-SEMIO oracle registration.
#   `reader`   (src/📖️reader_main.rs) — the per-kind before/after recipe corpus, backs the NEW
#                                     `gif-89a-any-mutate-reader` THIRD-PARTY-LIBRARY oracle. Its
#                                     `project` subcommand deliberately uses ONLY `gif::Decoder`'s
#                                     public getters — never the raw-block-scan technique
#                                     `🦀️oracle.rs` uses to fill the crate's read gaps —
#                                     so witnessability here is what a genuine reader can prove, not
#                                     what a second implementation can compute.
#
# 🧭️ Named `src/📖️reader_main.rs`, NOT Cargo's default `src/bin/reader.rs` convention: the repo root
# `.gitignore` has a blanket `[Bb]in/` rule (meant for build-output `bin/` dirs) that silently
# swallows anything under a `src/bin/` path too — confirmed with `git check-ignore`. Editing the
# shared root `.gitignore` is out of this subset's scope, so the file lives beside `main.rs`
# instead and `path` below points at it explicitly.
[workspace]
members = ["../../../../🧫️fixtures/📦️packages/🦀️rust"]

[workspace.metadata.semio.repository]
exclude-patterns = []
schema-version = 1
member-manifests = ["Cargo.toml"]

[package]
name = "gif-89a-any-fixture-generator"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "generate"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "reader"
path = "../../📖️reader/🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
gif = "0.13"
